title: Unbihexium: Earth Observation, Geospatial, Remote Sensing and SAR Library for Python
description: Unbihexium is a Python library for Earth observation, geospatial analysis, remote sensing and synthetic aperture radar (SAR). It provides raster and vector input and output (GeoTIFF, Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF, Zarr, GeoParquet, GeoJSON and STAC catalogues), spectral indices, SAR processing (calibration, speckle filtering, polarimetric decomposition and interferometry), terrain analysis, geostatistics (variograms and kriging), tiled inference pipelines, a command line interface, a FastAPI based REST service, and a model zoo of 130 capabilities in four size variants (tiny, base, large and mega) for object detection, semantic segmentation, change detection, classification and regression. Models run with ONNX Runtime or PyTorch on CPU or GPU. The library supports CPython 3.10 to 3.14 on Linux, macOS and Windows.
